definitions.days_since_last_discount: Elapsed UTC days since latest qualifying pre-cutoff discount observation.
definitions.days_since_last_price_record: Elapsed UTC days since latest valid pre-cutoff price observation.
definitions.game_age_days: Sale-start Pacific calendar date minus source-reported release date; date-resolution days.
definitions.has_prior_discount_observation: 1 if at least one qualifying pre-cutoff discount observation exists, otherwise 0.
definitions.has_prior_price_history: 1 if at least one valid pre-cutoff price observation exists, otherwise 0.
definitions.last_observed_discount_pct: Explicit cut at latest valid pre-cutoff observation; null for conflicting latest timestamp.
definitions.last_observed_price: Amount at latest valid pre-cutoff observation, only with exclusively USD prior valid prices and no latest-timestamp conflict.
definitions.max_prior_discount_pct: Maximum explicit cut percentage among qualifying pre-cutoff discounts.
definitions.mean_prior_discount_pct: Arithmetic mean explicit cut percentage among qualifying pre-cutoff discounts.
definitions.prior_discount_count: Count of qualifying discounted observations among prior_price_record_count; not campaigns.
definitions.prior_discount_rate: prior_discount_count / prior_price_record_count; observation-level ratio, not discounted-day share.
definitions.prior_price_record_count: Count of independently parser-valid pre-cutoff Steam price observations; duplicates retained.
definitions.release_month: Month (1–12) of the normalized source-reported release date.
definitions.release_quarter: Quarter (1–4) of the normalized source-reported release date.
definitions.release_year: Year of the normalized source-reported release date.
